timeline.title: Cenizas Labs Pvt Ltd
timeline.desc: Engineered a LLM-powered spreadsheet system with graph-based formula evaluation using dependency tracking, cycle detection, and BFS-based cascade recomputation for efficient update propagation. Built modular subsystems for state management(Undo/ Redo), formatting, copy - paste propagation, and charting(Chart.js), along with ExcelJS - based XLSX and CSV import/export. Built integrations with Salesforce to enable live data pull / push between external platforms and spreadsheet workflows, including real - time sync, record updates, and reusable API - based pipelines. Integrated Stripe payment system using Embedded Checkout with webhook - driven, idempotent backend and BullMQ - based asynchronous processing to ensure reliable, retry - safe transaction handling.
